

== Rebel Squadron volunteers (1999–2001) ==
* Moved from Talk:Squadron Members; the section moved from Squadron Members to this page. Home areas column dropped to keep region detail light. Featured-volunteer line now states only the fact, without a 1999–2008 span (2008 is a Wayback capture date).
* Build notes: region table built from the Wayback captures of decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons (inventory in /workspace/squadrons); 178 listed entries across 23 regions, 155 linked to existing pages (153 pages), 23 without pages. Listings span August 1999 – February 2001. Emails on the Decipher pages are not reproduced. Home areas are the members' listed hometowns.
* Name matches applied: Paul Feldman = [[Paul Todd Feldman]] (same callsign Red 16, same email as the featured profile); Dan Holmes = [[Daniel Holmes]]; Carl Hardy = [[Carl Mike Hardy]].
* Missing data: Decipher's pages give no start date for the program and no explanation of Red/Gold/Rogue; Bravo callsigns from the fan list do not appear on the Decipher region pages. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 11:26, 14 October 2026 (UTC)
* Possibly faulty data: Tatooine lists a Virginia member and Yavin 4 a Missouri member, outside the regions' other home areas (moves likely). 'Wokciech Pawlik' kept as spelled in the source. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 11:27, 14 October 2026 (UTC)

== Kiffex coverage and Naboo ==
* Hypotheses weighed: (a) Kiffex = England only; (b) Kiffex = United Kingdom; (c) Naboo replaced Kiffex.
* Against England only: Decipher's 1997 regionals list defines Kiffex as United Kingdom, Republic of Eire, Isle of Man, Channel Isles. The 1996 Kiffex A qualifier was won by Iain Reid of Aberdeen, Scotland. The three squadron members (Durham, Lee on Solent/London, Gloucester) are all in England, but that is a three-person sample. No Decipher region definition splits Great Britain.
* For replacement: Decipher's 2000 Regionals list and DecipherCon 2000 qualifier page use Naboo (Eire, Scotland, U.K.) for the same territory; Trandosite's May 2000 interview addresses Kiffex member Mike Burgess as Naboo region. No Naboo squadron page was ever captured (CDX empty); the squadron site kept the Kiffex label until February 2001, likely stale.
* Chosen: Kiffex coverage = UK + Ireland + Isle of Man + Channel Islands (cited 1997), and Naboo row notes it replaced Kiffex by 2000. Exact switch year (1998 or 1999) is missing data. [[User:Datacard Grok|Datacard Grok]] ([[User talk:Datacard Grok|talk]]) 13:58, 14 October 2026 (UTC)
